project.name: The Gym
project.axes: x east, y north, z up (same as Blender world)

datum.label: ±0.00 = Floor 1 finished floor (west wing)
datum.note: 496.30 masl: just above the erased plateau at the building (496.1).

site.water_level_note: Plunge pool along the west wing: F3 + 1.0 (waist height). Set by the rock sill at station T1.

ravine.note: Parametric ravine, north to south. Between stations everything is interpolated along the centerline. bed/water in m relative to ±0.00; half_bed = half the riverbed width; wall_w/wall_e = wall angle (deg) on the west/east side; rock = hard rock reach (crisp rims, steep walls). Shape rules from terrain/principles/elverum_gorge.json.

stations.note: sauna dipping pool, 1.3 m deep, calm
rock weir: holds the pool, keeps it calm above the falls
falls 1 lip, under the rustic bridge
rock sill: sets the pool level

pads.note: rock shelf cut down so the garage's west wall is exposed: floor-to-ceiling glass over the ravine (extended along the game room)

features.note: Site works carved into the terrain by terrain/ravine.py. Coordinates in project metres, z relative to ±0.00.

road.entry: east edge of the core at y = 0
road.note: ends at the drop-off loop; no parking at the main entrance

garage_ramp.note: branches off the road at x 128, open cut, then tunnel into the underground parking at x 60 (about 12%)

daycare_garden.note: organic sunken play garden: free-form floor off the daycare glass, terrace rings stepping up to the forest on the north and east; natural stone wall on the west (trail side). Edit 'outline'.

sauna.note: sod-roof badstue, set into the bank

sauna_path.note: from the sauna lobby annex on the gym's west wall

trail.surface: compacted gravel / forest path, low bollard lights

crossings.name: north footbridge over the real stream

trail.note: Loop: rustic bridge, past the sauna, north through the forest on the west side, high timber footbridge over the upstream stream, a wide sweep east over the flat plateau, back past the sunken garden to the rustic bridge. Routed direction-aware (grade along the path), so banks are taken diagonally.

surfaces.note: drop-off loop, one way, around a planted island
one big old pine, boulders, moss
entry meadow: soft grass, no paving; stepping stones lead to the door (on ~1 m of soil over the underground parking)
trailhead parking: 8 spaces, gravel, between kept trees; trailhead sign + connector to the loop
outdoor garden terrace (Roman's sketch): lawn between the two stair towers, opening off stretching & mobility
timber training deck: weatherproof rig, kettlebells, mats; sliding glass from the stretching room

paths.note: lit forest path from the trailhead lot to the entry meadow
from the garden terrace north behind the building into the sauna path and the trail

bike_shelter.note: covered bike shelter: timber frame, sod roof, ~30 bikes + e-bike charging, open to the meadow

trailhead_sign.note: trailhead kiosk: two log posts, sod-roofed gable, map panel (park-style, Nordic build)

outdoor_rig.note: outdoor calisthenics rig on the training deck: pull-up bars at 3 heights, parallel bars, galvanised steel + timber

envelope_placeholders.note: Temporary walls for the east wing lower level (E2) until the real building is designed.

glazed.note: daycare: walk-out to the sunken garden

structure.status: PROPOSAL v2: no interior columns on any floor (Roman: as column-free as possible, none on the top floor)
structure.concept: Concrete below, timber above, stone outside. Reinforced concrete wherever there is earth or water (F2-F4, E2; watertight on the river side, F4 slab rock-anchored against uplift). Glulam + CLT for the F1/E1 halls and roofs. Foundations bear on bedrock.

wings.note: Gym. Zero interior columns. Floors span 23.1 m wall to wall on post-tensioned concrete beams (~1.1 m deep) every 7.7 m with a 250 mm slab; F1 roof spans 23.1 m on glulam beams (~1.3 m deep). Below grade, lines A and C are concrete walls (retaining wall west, river wall east); on F1 they are glulam facade columns.
